title: Nonzero base scalars act injectively on sections of an invertible module
statement: Let A be a domain, let f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A) be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], and let L be an invertible module on X [def-sc-invertible-module]. For every a\in A\setminus\{0\}, multiplication by the image of a under A\simeq\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}(A),\mathcal O)\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X) is injective on \Gamma(X,L). No properness, finite-presentation, valuation, or nonemptiness hypothesis is needed.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma lemma-triviality-generic-fibre-valuation-ring, general-case proof, torsion-freeness of global sections by flatness

proof.text: Choose affine neighbourhoods U_x with free generators e_x of L. Local invertibility supplies these neighbourhoods; they cover X.

Flatness gives flat maps on the affine charts (Mathlib Scheme.Hom.flat_appLE). Compose with GammaSpecIso.inv using RingHom.Flat.of_bijective and RingHom.Flat.comp. Module.Flat.isSMulRegular_of_nonZeroDivisors then makes multiplication by each nonzero a injective on Gamma(U_x,O).

Write restrictions of s,t as b e_x,c e_x. Restrict as=at, use map_smul, and cancel the free generator to get a b=a c in Gamma(U_x,O). The preceding injection gives b=c, so the restricted sections agree. TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' on the covering U_x gives s=t.

lean.statement:
theorem injective_smul_sections_of_flat
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) [Flat f]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (a : A) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (fun s : Γ(L, ⊤) ↦
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom a • s)
